name: Neon Cluster
description: Blue-backlit analog automotive instrument cluster with a live nav panel, built from a rider-supplied reference image following skills/rydr-track-hud-theme.
author: RydR (built-in)

slots.notes: Direct match to the reference's own center gauge — its baked-in 20-280 tick range and 'mph' label already correspond to RydR's real speed data. Live RydRGauges SVG (ticks/needle) draws on top of this chrome asset. Reference's ring is a uniform blue throughout, no redline — sampled directly from the source image, not the app's own accent color, per the 'one fixed style' rule.

Substituted from the reference's tachometer (1-8, redline zone) — confirmed with rider. Bezel chrome reused; ticks/numbers are drawn live by RydRGauges (0-60 degrees), not the source's baked '1-8'/RPM labels. The reference's ring isn't a flat blue + abrupt redline — it's a continuous blue-to-pink-to-red sweep, sampled directly from the source image at low/mid/high angular positions and reproduced via gaugeGradient rather than the default flat-color+redlineFrom look.
No image asset — live map renders here. See map-style.json for the dark-navy/cyan-route style matching the reference panel.
Substituted from the reference's C-H coolant-temperature hash-mark gauge with real ambient weather temperature — confirmed with rider.
Substituted from the reference's P/gear-selector indicator with RydR's Recording/Paused/Not Recording status — confirmed with rider.

Only the warning-triangle telltale is still baked into this strip — ECO and fuel-pump both had real substitutions found (see heading-badge, spotify-thumbnail below) and are now holes punched in this asset, same as the sun icon before them.

Substituted from the reference's warning-triangle telltale — confirmed with rider. No image asset: the baked triangle in decorative-icon-stack.png stays as its dim/off look, this slot only adds a bright glow overlay on top while RydR has a real active NOAA weather alert (activeAlerts.length > 0) — never fabricated, off by default.

Substituted from the reference's static sun icon — confirmed with rider. Hole punched in both background.png and decorative-icon-stack.png at this position; the live weather emoji (RydRUtils.weatherEmoji, same one on the main dashboard) renders here instead, so it actually reflects current conditions rather than always showing a sun.

Substituted from the reference's ECO badge — rider's own suggestion, not proposed by the agent. Hole punched in background.png/decorative-icon-stack.png; a live compass-direction label (N/NE/E/...) renders in the badge's frame instead of the fixed 'ECO' text.

Substituted from the reference's fuel-pump icon — rider's own suggestion. Hole punched in background.png/decorative-icon-stack.png; shows the current Spotify track's album art when a track is playing, hidden (falls back to no art) when nothing is.

Substituted from the reference's E-F fuel gauge — rider's own suggestion: E (empty) to F (full) reads naturally as playback position, start to end. No hole punched — the baked E/F hash-mark frame stays as chrome, a live fill bar overlays it (using the Spotify Web Playback API's progress_ms/duration_ms, already read by js/spotify.js's RydRSpotify.getState().nowPlaying) growing left-to-right as the current track plays. Hidden when nothing is playing.
